sourceCoordinates: Blender +Y forward / +Z up; exported once to glTF -Z forward / +Y up

feet.construction: continuous cannon/carpus/hock/fetlock/pastern; single horn wall and recessed sole, short rear feathering
feet.appearance: reference-led creative anatomy; dimensions are authoring choices

upperForelegs.construction: reference-aligned elbow/carpus with separately fitted continuous forearm surface

coat.method: individual skinned short fibres, limited alpha-cutout edge tufts and tiled fibre normal detail on UV1
coat.bodyShape: measured body and foot stance, closed rebuilt neck, rounded sternum, corrected eyes, nasal apertures, ears, mane and tail brush
coat.pigment: calibrated three-view charcoal gray, pale underside and short muzzle; dark chest, coarse short fibre microcontrast
coat.detailNormalUv: FurDetailUV; measured short-coat flow, 0.45 m per texture repeat
coat.shadow: groomCastShadow=false; body and accessories cast shadows, micro-fibre layer receives them

motion: Advance the root along local -Z. Walk time = distance / 0.68 * 1.2 seconds; Idle uses an independent 3-second clock.

derivation.scope: animal body, eyes, ears, mane, tail and short fur only; no cart, shafts, collar, straps, halter or lead rope

appearance.source: user original donkey three-view; cart side image used only for animal identity
appearance.animation: re-solve both clips against refined joint heights; original stride and duration retained
appearance.material: neutral gray-brown short coat, fine directional fibres, pale belly and muzzle
appearance.shape: more upright neck/poll, extended muzzle, rounded abdomen, locally smoothed shoulder/hamstring, fuller short mane and narrower ear splay

coat.method: individual skinned short fibres, limited alpha-cutout edge tufts and tiled fibre normal detail on UV1
coat.bodyShape: measured body and foot stance, closed rebuilt neck, rounded sternum, corrected eyes, nasal apertures, ears, mane and tail brush
coat.pigment: calibrated three-view charcoal gray, pale underside and short muzzle; dark chest, coarse short fibre microcontrast
coat.detailNormalUv: FurDetailUV; measured short-coat flow, 0.45 m per texture repeat

nasalSurfaceFairing.method: quadratic fairing from intact surrounding muzzle

nostrils.method: curved alar opening around an elliptic nasal pad; shaded mucosal wall and dark airway floor
curved alar opening around an elliptic nasal pad; shaded mucosal wall and dark airway floor

legFit.method: surface cross-section volume fit; fuller forearms and cannon shafts, restrained fetlocks, straighter far foreleg; unchanged horn and soles

hooves.method: rounded existing horn rings, fuller coronet and inset heel; existing standing rim and rigid hoof weights preserved

surface.runtime: shallow real horn relief; baked existing UV0 base, normal and ORM; no additional runtime material or image

faceSculpt.method: rounded interaural crown, subtle supraorbital ridge and connected throat junction fairing

abdomenFit.method: measured side underside with smooth Hermite displacement, lateral/height falloffs; original topology and weights retained

binding.method: ventral trunk follows pelvis/thorax; smooth groin and lateral transition retains leg skin

volumeFibres.spread: broad rooted bundles narrow into connected reference foreground lobes, with dense shorter interior fill; global reference height preserves the tip envelope

mane.method: reference-alpha ribbons backed by thin curved triangular-tube fibres rooted to actual skin

eyes.method: seated cornea with eyelid margin and inner orbital fur following the actual ellipsoid surface

nasalPad.normal: fine 0.25 mm procedural skin relief baked on UV0; no coarse repeated fibre normal
nasalPad.pigment: reference blend strengthened below the upper white muzzle; soft height transition

referenceFit.standingPose: far forefoot forward, far hindfoot forward; centred foot targets during walk
referenceFit.shape: broader muzzle/skull and barrel, shorter axial silhouette, corrected eye height, back/belly profile and sternum
referenceFit.material: visible full-RGB reference coat/face pigment with illumination compensation; anatomical apertures and hidden pixels retain calibrated fallback; independent 0.45 m fibre-normal repeat

colorCalibration.basis: matched neutral studio illumination and visible original three-view coat patches

flow.method: integrated side-flow chart with anatomical leg charts

photoDetail.method: masked luminance / normalized local blur; two 9-pixel box passes; original detail contrast 2.30 and guide detail contrast 1.0; ratios clamped separately
photoDetail.cavityProtection: feathered source nostril shadows and oral crease/highlight footprints excluded from pigment-like detail; anatomical creases remain geometry
photoDetail.occlusionMasks: _blender/Script_DonkeyReferenceMasks.py; geometric rope footprints including shaded edges; feathered normalized-detail blending
photoDetail.visibility: fitted-skin BVH depth test from axial source cameras; 4 mm surface tolerance; source-vertex weights baked into UV0
photoDetail.runtime: baked UV0 base colour; independent tiled UV1 fibre normal; no camera projection in GLB

pigmentProjection.method: full reference RGB with per-view normal-based illumination compensation for body and facial fur; hairless nasal pad keeps its independent skin material; anatomical feature footprints and hidden/background pixels retain calibrated appearance
pigmentProjection.nasalCavityProtection: source cavity and oral crease/highlight footprints excluded from colour projection

fineCompensation.sourceSampling: Closest during offline bake; ordinary filtered runtime sampler unchanged

pigmentProjection.runtime: offline UV0 bake into existing 2K base; no additional runtime image, material, camera projection or shader

derivation.skeleton: 28 bone names and hierarchy retained; reference rest joints and standing foot offsets updated, walk/idle re-solved. Unused DonkeyHitchPivot retained for compatibility.

verification.sourceAnatomyEvidence: Measured three-view silhouette, closed manifold neck/skin, orbital relief, rebuilt eyes and swept nasal cavities; compatible rest joints and four-influence skin. Native clips and the packed GLB are independently sampled.
